public_rationale: The approximate construction benchmark is supported. JLL's contemporaneous research puts the global average build time for a 50MW facility at 18 months, matching the scale and rough duration of the ordinary reading. This does not verify a precise majority statistic, every example in the post, or the time needed to complete an entire multi-phase campus.
limitations: Support is for a rough typical construction duration, not a universal groundbreaking-to-revenue deadline.
JLL's benchmark concerns 50MW facilities and does not explicitly define the operational-opening endpoint.
Treating for the most part as a strict majority claim would require additional distributional evidence.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Zitron was only able to find a few data centers that definitively opened, and for the most part it appears that a data center takes around 18 months to go from groundbreaking to opening.

statement.excerpt: For example, I was only able to find a few data centers that for sure, categorically, definitively opened, and for the most part, it appears that a data center takes around 18 months to go from groundbreaking to opening.
statement.document_title: Where Are All The Data Centers?

our_interpretation: Read this as an approximate typical construction duration for ordinary individual facilities comparable to his examples, rather than a universal deadline or a claim about fully completed gigawatt campuses.
The contextual period is the recent construction and opening experience discussed in the post, from 2024 through its publication date.
Groundbreaking starts the clock; prior land acquisition, permitting, and equipment procurement do not.
An industry construction benchmark can support the ordinary approximate claim, but it does not establish that a specified percentage of projects opened within an exact interval.
criteria.support_condition: Credible industry measurements or representative project evidence place the typical construction duration for comparable facilities near 18 months.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable industry measurements or representative completed-project evidence establish a typical groundbreaking-to-opening duration materially different from approximately 18 months.
